content.name: Liliel Angel Paratroopers/Ririsa
content.description: Super Rare light aircraft carrier. Angel’s Stage L, day 1: defeat 100 enemies. Claim the mission reward; construction is unavailable.

content.name: Miriella Angel Paratroopers/Mikari
content.description: Super Rare light cruiser. Angel’s Stage M, day 1: earn 10 S-rank victories and claim the mission reward. Construction is unavailable.

content.name: Liliel’s Rod
content.description: Ririsa only. Stage L day 2 reward: 250 enemies. AVI 32 → 40 and RLD 9 → 15 at +10; Liliel’s Explosion upgrades at +10.

content.name: Miriella’s Bow
content.description: Mikari only. Stage M day 1 login reward. FP 25 → 35 and ACC 5 → 15 at +10; Miriella’s Resonance upgrades at +10.

content.name: Angel Paratroopers
content.description: Both exclusive augments add 10 percentage points to slot 1 efficiency in battle, plus 5 with another 2.5 Dimensional Seduction ship in the fleet.

content.name: Angel’s Stage L
content.description: Daily cumulative enemy targets, days 1–7: 100 / 250 / 400 / 600 / 850 / 1,150 / 1,500. Rewards: Ririsa; Rod; Liliel shell; Rod torpedo; Ririsa suitcase; Wings; Liliel halo.

content.name: Stage M · Day 1
content.description: S-rank victories ×10 → Mikari; Login → Bow.

content.name: Stage M · Day 2
content.description: Commissions ×2 → T2 tech packs ×2; Exercises ×2 → Coins ×100.

content.name: Stage M · Day 3
content.description: Daily Challenges ×3 → T2 parts ×6; Retire ships ×2 → Bow torpedo.

content.name: Stage M · Day 4
content.description: Tactical training ×2 → T2 books ×4; Enhance ships ×5 → Wings.

content.name: Stage M · Day 5
content.description: Defeat enemies ×20 → Mikari suitcase; Restock dorm snacks ×5 → T3 tech packs ×2.

content.name: Stage M · Day 6
content.description: Open tech box ×1 → T3 parts ×6; Build ships ×2 → Miriella shell.

content.name: Stage M · Day 7
content.description: Tactical training ×2 → Miriella halo; Defeat boss fleets ×3 → T3 books ×4.

content.name: Daily mission and claim gates
content.description: Stage L opens one mission daily through November 18; complete the preceding mission to reveal the next. Stage M records progress together, but reward groups open daily and must be claimed in order.
